positive_findings: Workflow code orchestrates deterministic agent state and does not perform model, tool, or database I/O directly.
Model, tool, and Lakebase operations are separate activities with independent timeouts and retry policies.
Lakebase operational tables are normalized for UI polling, notifications, audit, and downstream sync.
Lakebase Change Data Feed is documented as a Public Preview schema-level enablement step instead of an implicit automatic flush.
The EKS runtime uses off-platform Databricks OAuth service principals, Lakebase endpoint credentials, and SSL.
remaining_gaps: Production identity, scale, and Unity Catalog destination choices remain open.
No live Databricks Lakebase integration test has been run because credentials and profile selection are environment-specific.
No live Temporal Server execution has been run in this scaffold validation unless started separately.
